text_name.description: The full name of the text, e.g., 'Taittiriya Upanishad'.

structure_levels.description: An ordered list of names for the structural levels, from largest to smallest, e.g., ['Valli', 'Anuvaka', 'Mantra'].

content.description: An array of the top-level structural nodes (e.g., an array of Valli objects).

node.description: A node can be either a structural container or a content leaf.

type.description: The type of this node, matching a name from structure_levels, e.g., 'Valli', 'Anuvaka'.

name.description: The name of this node, e.g., 'Anandavalli'. Optional.

number.description: The sequential number of this node within its parent.

children.description: An array of child nodes (which can be more structural nodes or leaf nodes).

type.description: The type of this leaf node, e.g., 'Mantra', 'Sutra'.

number.description: The sequential number of this leaf within its parent.

text.description: The main content of the leaf node.
